# APT Notes by HECAVEX

> A source-backed public catalogue of threat actors, campaigns, software, techniques, relationships and attribution claims.

APT Notes is a static, read-only research publication. Preserve source-specific naming and attribution boundaries: a shared victim, tool, infrastructure node or technique is not sufficient on its own to equate two actor labels. The catalogue is curated rather than exhaustive and has no account, write or monitoring API.

## Primary pages

- [Overview](https://apt.hecavex.com/): Product scope and featured dossiers.
- [Actors](https://apt.hecavex.com/actors/): Reviewed threat-actor dossiers.
- [Knowledge](https://apt.hecavex.com/knowledge/): Campaign, software, technique and reference catalogue.
- [Relationships](https://apt.hecavex.com/relationships/): Explicit actor-to-technique procedure evidence.
- [Changes](https://apt.hecavex.com/changes/): Chronological substantive change record.
- [Methodology](https://apt.hecavex.com/about/methodology/): Source hierarchy, attribution, confidence, review and corrections.
- [About](https://apt.hecavex.com/about/): Purpose, scope, audience, workflow and limitations.
- [Licence](https://apt.hecavex.com/licence/): Software, research, source and trademark terms.

Secondary records normally open in a panel for uninterrupted browsing. Their canonical HTML routes remain addressable and are suitable for direct links. Actor dossiers remain full pages.

## Release discovery

- [Catalogue index](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/index.json): Counts and canonical JSON, CSV, record and feed locations.
- [Release manifest](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/version.json): Dataset/schema versions, release metadata, counts and principal assets.
- [Knowledge index](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/knowledge.json): Compact cross-entity discovery records.
- [Changes Atom feed](https://apt.hecavex.com/changes/feed.xml): Additions, corrections, lifecycle and relationship changes.
- [Compatibility Atom feed](https://apt.hecavex.com/feed.xml): The same bounded Changes stream at the historical feed address.

Every JSON document includes schema version, dataset version, release ID, release time, publisher, licence, methodology and a publication notice. The outputs are deterministic static files, not live query endpoints.

## JSON datasets

- [Actors](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/actors.json)
- [Campaigns](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/campaigns.json)
- [Malware](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/malware.json)
- [Tools](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/tools.json)
- [Software](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/software.json): Combined malware and tool view.
- [Techniques](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/techniques.json)
- [Sources](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/sources.json)
- [References](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/references.json): Public alias of the Sources dataset.
- [Relationships](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/relationships.json)
- [Changes](https://apt.hecavex.com/api/changes.json)

Per-record JSON convention: `https://apt.hecavex.com/api/{collection}/{slug}.json`. Relationship records use their stable relationship ID in place of a slug.

## Interpretation boundary

Broad entity arrays are catalogue mappings. The Relationships dataset is deliberately narrower and is generated only from explicit procedure evidence in public actor dossiers. Relationship confidence is an editorial evidence assessment, not a probability or proof of current activity.

Do not infer that two vendor clusters are equivalent merely because they share a technique, campaign, tool, victim or infrastructure. Preserve evidence text, references, confidence, lifecycle state and review/version fields when reusing a record.
